# 13 - Resources

Counted from the registries that define it. Run `pnpm census` after changing
a tool, a skill, a prompt, a role, a command or a guardrail;
`tests/docs/census-generated.test.mjs` compares this file against the live
registry, so a stale copy fails the build instead of misleading a reader.

## MCP resources (186)

A resource is read with `resources/read`, and every one is JSON or markdown
a client can cache: no call runs a model, and none of them writes.

### The fixed indexes

| URI                     | Name                                                    | Media type         |
| ----------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------ |
| `rule://skills`          | All rule skills index                                    | `application/json` |
| `rule://templates`       | Design system component templates                       | `application/json` |
| `rule://project`         | Project analysis (detected framework + suggested tools) | `application/json` |
| `rule://community`       | Community rule skills index                              | `application/json` |
| `rule://ai`              | rule skill full content                                  | `text/markdown`    |
| `rule://a11y`            | A11y testing guide (Playwright + axe-core)              | `text/markdown`    |
| `rule://a11y/test-basic` | Basic a11y test template                                | `text/plain`       |
| `rule://a11y/test-forms` | Form a11y test template                                 | `text/plain`       |

### Per skill

178 more, two for each skill that mints them:

- `rule://<skill>` - the whole `SKILL.md`
- `rule://<skill>/summary` - the condensed form a router hands back

Listing them one row at a time would restate [`06-skills.md`](06-skills.md).
